summary: EF 董事会宣布 Tomasz Stańczak 卸任联席执行董事，任命 Bastian Aue 为临时联席执行董事，与 Hsiao-Wei 共同领导。Tomasz 在个人文章中说将于 2 月底离任。ethereum 账号介绍隐私收款应用 Fluidkey。协议规范层面较安静。

items.title: EF 博客：执行领导层更新
items.note: （EF Board）：Tomasz Stańczak 决定卸任联席执行董事，董事会任命 Bastian Aue 为临时联席执行董事，即日生效；EF 博客：来自 Tomasz 的更新：他将于 2026 年 2 月底卸任，Bastian Aue 与 Hsiao-Wei 共同担任联席执行董事。
items.note_en: (EF Board): Tomasz Stańczak decided to step down as Co-Executive Director and the Board appointed Bastian Aue as interim Co-Executive Director, effective immediately; EF blog: An update from Tomasz: he steps down at the end of February 2026, with Bastian Aue serving as Co-ED alongside Hsiao-Wei.

items.title: EF 博客：来自 Tomasz 的更新
items.note: EF 博客：执行领导层更新（EF Board）：Tomasz Stańczak 决定卸任联席执行董事，董事会任命 Bastian Aue 为临时联席执行董事，即日生效；EF 博客：来自 Tomasz 的更新：他将于 2026 年 2 月底卸任，Bastian Aue 与 Hsiao-Wei 共同担任联席执行董事。

items.note_en: EF blog: Executive Leadership Update (EF Board): Tomasz Stańczak decided to step down as Co-Executive Director and the Board appointed Bastian Aue as interim Co-Executive Director, effective immediately; EF blog: An update from Tomasz: he steps down at the end of February 2026, with Bastian Aue serving as Co-ED alongside Hsiao-Wei.

keywords_en: EF leadership change with Tomasz Stańczak stepping down as Co-Executive Director
Bastian Aue appointed interim Co-Executive Director
ZK proofs come to optimistic L2s
summary_en: The EF Board announced that Tomasz Stańczak is stepping down as Co-Executive Director and appointed Bastian Aue as interim Co-Executive Director alongside Hsiao-Wei. Tomasz wrote that he leaves at the end of February. The ethereum account featured the private payments app Fluidkey. Protocol spec work was quiet.
